environment.hardware: cloud development host; not Raspberry Pi

method.measurement: _build_data_response plus compact UTF-8 JSON serialization; perf_counter_ns timings
method.isolation: Temporary runtime copy and settings; HTTP forbidden; workers disabled
method.freshness: Synthetic successful-fetch monotonic stamps and actual event signatures; expiry asserted
method.p95: Nearest-rank percentile, sorted sample at ceil(0.95 * 300) - 1
method.heap: tracemalloc retained allocation delta over 50 extra renders after gc; RSS is process high-water

limits: Synthetic cached data; excludes network latency, Chromium, image loading and SD writes.
Different host load/fixtures/JSON serialization can affect comparison with previous benchmarks.
Short benchmark is not proof against leaks or a 24/7 soak test.
No Raspberry Pi CPU/RAM/temperature measurements were made.
